About Dominion AI Agency

A small agency in East Texas that sets up AI on the phones and websites of small businesses, and tells you exactly who is doing the work.

Call (903) 636-7511 What we are not

Our own line is answered by the AI receptionist we set up for clients. Call it and judge for yourself.

  1. Home
  2. About

Who we are

Dominion AI Agency is a trade name (d/b/a) used by Dominion Digital Group, a Black-owned company in East Texas that Maurice Johnson founded in 2022.

We are a small AI automation agency, not a software company. We do not sell you a login. We set up AI receptionists and voice agents, website chat and voice widgets, appointment booking, CRM pipelines with email follow-up, review requests and websites for small businesses, and then we keep them running.

Maurice sets up each system. When you talk to us about your business, you are talking to the person who will configure your agent.

Why our own phone line is answered by AI

It would be strange to sell AI receptionists and then send our own calls to voicemail. Our main line is answered around the clock by an AI receptionist built the same way as the ones we set up for clients.

That gives you something most sales pages cannot: a working sample you can test on your own terms. Call at an odd hour. Ask it something off script. Notice what it does well and where it hands off. If you would not want something like it answering your customers, you have learned that for free.

Call the main line and judge the product for yourself. It is the same kind of agent we would put on your line.

Call (903) 636-7511

Why we build on HighLevel

Every system we set up runs on HighLevel, a widely used platform for small business marketing and automation. It covers the pieces our clients need in one place: voice AI agents, conversation AI for chat, calendars, a CRM with pipelines, workflows and email.

Building on an established platform rather than a homemade tool means your setup is not a mystery only one person understands. The platform has its own documentation and support, and the pieces it uses are standard.

We also link to HighLevel on our tools page, with a clear note that those are referral links.

What we are, and what we are not

We are

  • A small agency that does the setup and the upkeep itself
  • Built on HighLevel
  • Remote, serving all 50 states from East Texas
  • Upfront about prices, which are on the pricing page
  • Plain about limits, which every service page lists

We are not

  • A call center, or a staff of human receptionists
  • A software company building custom AI models
  • A source of legal, medical or tax advice
  • A HIPAA compliance program
  • A company that will invent reviews, client counts or results to sell you

Texting, stated up front

Some of what we set up depends on business texting, which requires carrier registration. Ours is not approved yet, so we say so on every page that mentions it rather than in fine print.

Texting is not live yet. Voice works today. Text messages (missed call text back, text reminders and texted review requests) switch on once carrier approval clears; that approval is the A2P 10DLC registration US carriers require for business texting from a regular local number. Everything else, including the AI answering calls and email follow-up, works today.

Questions about the company

Who owns Dominion AI Agency?

Maurice Johnson, the founder of Dominion Digital Group. Dominion AI Agency is a trade name of his company, Dominion Digital Group, which he started in 2022. He also sets up the client systems himself.

Where is Dominion AI Agency located?

In East Texas. We do not publish a street address, and we do not need one for the work: every system is set up remotely, so we serve small businesses in all 50 states by phone, email and shared screen.

Is Dominion AI Agency Black-owned?

Yes. Dominion Digital Group, the company behind Dominion AI Agency, is Black-owned.

Do you have a team or a call center?

No, and we will not pretend to. There is no call center and no staff of human receptionists. The AI answers calls; Maurice configures and maintains the systems. If you need people answering your phones, a staffed answering service is a better fit, and our comparison guide explains the difference.

How is Dominion AI Agency related to Dominion Web Design Pro?

They are sister brands under Dominion Digital Group, along with AI Voice Agent Pros and Dominion Review Pro. Dominion Web Design Pro is the website brand, and its free demo builder is linked from our pages where a website comes up.

Hear the AI receptionist answer before you buy one

Call our main line. The AI receptionist that picks up is the same kind of agent we configure for clients, so you can test it with your own questions. Ask it about prices, setup or your industry, or leave a message for Maurice.
